scope: Authoring expression/AVT validation of exact-arity XSLT function keyword calls with every argument supplied.
architecture: Immutable frozen signature registry derived from retained declaration contexts and include/import occurrence ranks. No stylesheet compilation, evaluation or resource resolution is performed by signature capture or snapshot validation.
namespaces: Applicable fixed/native declaration namespaces; parameter-local bindings; unprefixed names in no namespace; undeclared host keyword prefixes report XPST0081.
sourcePreservation: Original bytes and public native namespace/QName descriptors unchanged. Repeated validation makes no resolver requests; namespace-document refusal is not retried.
publicApi: No public API addition; registry is retained internally on the snapshot.
boundaries: Pattern and expression-body keyword signature validation
Static use-when calls to ordinary stylesheet functions
upstream: Original five areas/14 cases and PR #27 three cases remain separate. Acceptance/independent confirmation remain pending.
